summary.text: Stephanie Hansen has represented Delaware Senate District 10 since winning a special election in early 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to her official page, Hansen was an environmental scientist and hydrologist at DNREC, served as president of New Castle County Council from 1996 to 2001, and practiced environmental and administrative law from 2001 to 2020.
She holds degrees in geology from the University of Delaware, earth science from the University of New Orleans, and law from Widener University.
